verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS observability platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, sites, or residency controls. The items cover the API, LLM/Agent Observability SDKs, the MCP server, and pricing and UX sentiment, none of which bear on where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
